data: Is the computation time for 'Game only' with 500 roll-outs higher than that of the 'Latent variable' method with 200 roll-outs?

To determine if the computation time for 'Game only' with 500 roll-outs is higher than that of the 'Latent variable' method with 200 roll-outs, I need to compare their respective positions on the x-axis (computation time per game step in seconds). From the figure, the 'Game only' line with 500 roll-outs appears at approximately 60 seconds on the x-axis, while the 'Latent variable' line with 200 roll-outs is around 80 seconds. Therefore, the computation time for 'Game only' with 500 roll-outs is lower than that of the 'Latent variable' method with 200 roll-outs.
The answer is no.
